name: memos
description_en: A personal timeline for quick notes. Write short memos, find them later by search, tag, or date. Open source and self-hosted.
readme_excerpt: > ✨ Featured Sponsor: CodeRabbit — Cut code review time & bugs in half, instantly. Memos Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app built for quick capture. It is Markdown-native, lightweight, and keeps your data under your control.
